evidence.detail: The class is a static chat classification utility whose integer constants are consumed by the gameframe chat-button renderer for the exact All/Game/Public/Private/Clan/Trade/News/Yell channel surfaces.

Its a(String,int) method reclassifies base chat messages into exact News, Yell and Clan-chat message types using surviving markers/text: '<img=2><shad=FFFF3F><col=FE610C> News: </shad></col>', '<y>', '<c>', 'Please wait at least ... each yell message!' and 'Clan Chat channel-mate'.
Its b(String,int) method removes the exact '<c>' and '<y>' transport/display markers only for the corresponding Clan and Yell message types.

Its c(String,int) method decides chat-line eligibility for base/news/yell/clan categories, including filtering generic system phrases and news-trigger vocabulary such as 'received', 'successfully enchanted', 'has killed', 'killstreak', 'has encountered' and 'just captured'.

Only rs/Client and rs/i/b consume the class. rs/Client uses the constants in chat rendering/filter logic; rs/i/b uses them while rendering exact gameframe chat channel buttons, fixing the responsibility to chat/message classification rather than general text processing.

proposals.note: ChatMessageClassifier is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the static chat type/channel classification utility. The entire class is confined to chat constants, message reclassification, marker normalization and filtering; confidence is 0.999.
